{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
n_total = len(treatment_only)
response_fraction = n_responded / n_total

print(f'Number of patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {n_total}')
print(f'Number of responders in treatment arm: {n_responded}')
print(f'Response fraction: {response_fraction}')"}
